verdict.rationale: Kino's desktop app runs an MCP server that ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can each connect to, so the same Kino toolset is reachable from multiple coding agents. Cloud agents such as Devin can also install Kino. The evidence does not show a packaged "collection" or any per-harness installation instructions. missing for 10: documented per-harness install instructions for each agent, an installable collection/skill bundle concept, setup details beyond a one-line claim, independent corroboration of cross-agent installs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the same collection into multiple different coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others — with per-harness instructions

citations.quote: The desktop app runs an MCP server, so ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can search your footage and edit your projects from their own chat.
Cloud agents like Dot, Muse, Grok Bot and Devin install Kino on their own computer and edit while you’re away.
